label: transferred territory to
definition: Political authority X transferred territorial control or sovereignty to authority Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit return of territory to Y; handover with a resolved territorial object and recipient; historical territorial transfer. Excludes: ordinary travel or a person returning to a place; generic ownership, defeat, or geographic proximity; a proposed transfer without realization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic return or handover with no resolved territorial object; unclear transfer direction or recipient; prospective or hypothetical handover. The transferred territory is an omitted third role and must be established by local evidence; do not supply it from historical knowledge.
